text:
incident-bot: Pager: SEV=high · p99 latency breach (dedicated) · affected customer: single-tenant NimbusLabs · channels: #incidents, @eng-runtime

Ravi Singh: seeing sudden p99 spike starting ~10:12 UTC. p95 moved 220ms -> 720ms, p99 1.1s -> 3.6s. Streaming stalls visible: clients get first chunk then silence ~600-1200ms.

Leah Kim: which model/pool?

Ravi Singh: rwd-7b-quant on pool nimbus-dedicated. Traffic pattern shows huge number of short-lived concurrent sessions (many 1-3 token prompts) at high fanout.

infra-bot: Pool metrics alert: CPU util on serving pods 93% avg, GPU util 48%, open connections spiked x6, batching window avg increased from 12ms -> 80ms.

Omar Haddad: open connections x6 + long batching window => batching is aggregating many tiny requests causing head-of-line delays for streaming. Could be config drift: batch_window_ms bumped in last deploy?

Sofia Torres: checked deploy history: batch_window_ms set to 80ms for nimbus pool in deploy at 09:59 UTC (deploy id d-9812) — likely too high for bursty short sessions.

Ravi Singh: reproduce query from logs (sanitized):
```
[10:11:58] tenant=nimbus user=svc-test prompt="status?" tokens=2
[10:11:58] tenant=nimbus user=svc-batch prompt="ok" tokens=1
[10:11:58] tenant=nimbus user=svc-x prompt="a" tokens=1
... many similar lines
```

Samir Dubey: quick mitigations we can do:
- reduce batch_window_ms to 10-15ms for this pool
- cap per-tenant concurrency in router (max_concurrency=30)
- enable per-request fastpath for short prompts (streaming_grace_ms=80)
- emergency add burst nodes to pool

Leah Kim: risk assessment: reducing batch window reduces throughput efficiency but should reduce tail for streaming. Per-request fastpath may bypass KV caching, minor quality perf hit.

Omar Haddad: executing immediate safe change: lower batch window to 15ms
```
rbctl config set --pool nimbus-dedicated batch_window_ms=15
```

infra-bot: Applied config change to pool nimbus-dedicated by Omar Haddad. Rolling update across 12 pods.

Ravi Singh: within 90s of change: p95 ~360ms, p99 ~1.8s, streaming stalls reduced but still intermittent.

Samir Dubey: next: cap tenant concurrency and enable fastpath for tiny prompts.
```
rbctl route update --tenant nimbuslabs --max_concurrency 30
rbctl config set --pool nimbus-dedicated streaming_grace_ms=80 enable_short_prompt_fastpath=true
```

infra-bot: Route updated: max_concurrency=30 for tenant nimbuslabs. Pool config updated: streaming_grace_ms=80, enable_short_prompt_fastpath=true (applied).

Ravi Singh: after both: p95 260ms, p99 1.1s, streaming stall rate ~0.015, batching window avg back to 14ms. Good stabilization.

Leah Kim: customer contacted via support: Nimbus Labs says they rolled a canary at 10:00 that increased short-session traffic. They will pause further canaries.

Sofia Torres: check KV cache metrics: evictions increased but only to 180/min (not the main driver here). Primary issue was batching latency + high connection fanout.

Omar Haddad: follow-ups I recommend:
- add deployment guard: config change to batch_window_ms > 30ms for pools serving heavy short-session tenants should require a canary flag and perf signoff
- create automatic rule: if open_connections > x and batching_window > 40ms => auto-shrink batch_window and enable fastpath for affected tenant
- investigate adaptive batching: dynamic window based on recent median request size

Samir Dubey: created ticket INF-6001: adaptive-batching-and-shortprompt-fastpath.

Ravi Singh: handing to next oncall (Grace) for 60m watch and postmortem draft. I'll remain reachable for 30m.

incident-bot: oncall handoff: @grace now oncall eng-runtime. Escalate to eng-platform if metrics regress in 20m.

Grace Liu: taking it. I'll validate 1h of stability and draft the incident doc.

Leah Kim: postmortem checklist starters:
- timeline & root cause: tenant canary + batch_window increase -> batching for many tiny requests -> head-of-line streaming stalls -> p99 breach
- mitigations: lowered batch_window, set tenant concurrency cap, enabled short-prompt fastpath, customer rollback/paused canary
- monitoring changes: add composite alert (batch_window_large AND open_conn_high), add synthetic short-prompt traffic test on dedicated pools
- customer comms: support to send summary and recommended deployment practices for short-session workloads

Sofia Torres: reproduction snippet for PM:
```
# simulate many tiny prompts
simctl run --tenant nimbuslabs --model rwd-7b-quant --pattern short-burst --qps 180 --prompt_len 1 --duration 10m
# watch batching window and p99
```

incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED (stabilized) · duration 01:06:01 · final p99 1.05s · actions: config rollback on batch_window + routing cap + fastpath enabled · severity downgraded to medium

Grace Liu: uploading metrics and will post full PM in #postmortems and link INF-6001. Thanks team.

Samir Dubey: quick note: no infra CPU/GPU faults; change was purely config + workload.

Leah Kim: closing thread at 11:18 UTC. :white_check_mark:
